Color-treated users scan a circular care-day ring to see rinse, mask, and gloss due nodes, quick-capture a care action into a water-matched plan, open that day’s agenda for dyed-hair routines, and export a period reminder card that shows due counts. Product data stays in the on-device H5 vault (no accounts, no cloud sync); the Swift shell hosts WebView, Bridge, and StoreKit only. Interaction topology is **T8_reminder_ring** — Hub Tab 1 is the calendar ring, never a tag/chip browse list. ## Screen Inventory | Route | Screen | Layer | Purpose | |-------|--------|-------|---------| | `#/splash` | Splash | H5 | Boot frame until `shellReady`; cyan–green gloss motif | | `#/welcome` | Welcome Gate | H5 | Three themed slides + agreement checkboxes; Continue → Tab 1 | | `#/ring` | Care Ring Hub | H5 · **Tab 1** | Reminder-ring calendar hero; care due nodes; signature spin/tap | | `#/plans` | Water Match Plans | H5 · **Tab 2** | Water-quality matched care plan panels (hardness / rinse recipe) | | `#/agenda` | Day Agenda | H5 · **Tab 3** | Selected-day / nearest-due care agenda for dyed-hair routines | | `#/settings` | Settings | H5 · **Tab 4** | Coins, free exports, legal entry, version (plaza gesture) | | `#/day` | Day Detail | H5 stack | Full agenda for one ring day; edit due / plan link | | `#/capture` | Quick Capture | H5 overlay | Capture care action into a water-matched plan (form module) | | `#/export` | Period Export | H5 stack | Preview + save period reminder card (same composition) | | `#/store` | Coin Store | H5 stack | Consumable Tints00–Tints17 dual zones | | `#/legal` | Legal Overlay | H5 hash overlay | Privacy / Terms via `formatLegalBody` stacked on base | | `#/plaza` | Bridge Plaza | H5 hidden | Long-press Settings version 3s; Bridge capability matrix | Native shell screens (not H5 routes): WebView host, LaunchVeil, offline Retry. ## Tab navigation (h5_shell) Bottom TabBar has **exactly four** tab-root routes (stack overlays do not count): | Tab | Route | Label (EN) | Role | |-----|-------|------------|------| | 1 | `#/ring` | Ring | T8 primary zone — care calendar ring / day nodes | | 2 | `#/plans` | Plans | Water-quality matched care schemes | | 3 | `#/agenda` | Agenda | Day agenda sorted by care urgency | | 4 | `#/settings` | Settings | Wallet, legal, version | Default after Welcome: Tab 1 `#/ring`. ## Interaction Topology - **Topology id:** `T8_reminder_ring` (Reminder ring) - **Primary modules:** `list` = calendar-ring · `form` = quick-capture · `detail` = day-agenda · `export` = period-reminder-card - **Main module:** Ring Hub (`#/ring`) — scan orbit nodes, open day, launch capture into water-matched plans - **Secondary modules:** Water Match Plans (`#/plans`), Agenda (`#/agenda`), Period export (`#/export`) - **Explicitly NOT:** tag/chip taxonomy as Hub home; category browse list as landing; legacy “chip → list → detail → weekly export” CRUD template ## Domain Model & Data Contract | Entity | Fields | Type | Validation | Persistence key | |--------|--------|------|------------|-----------------| | `WaterMatchPlan` | `id`, `planLabel`, `waterHardnessPpm`, `phBand`, `rinseRecipe`, `maskCadenceDays`, `glossCadenceDays`, `createdAt` | string / int / enum / ISO | `planLabel` 1–32 chars; `waterHardnessPpm` 0–500; cadence 1–30; unique `id` | `tintoo_plans_v1` | | `RingDayNode` | `dayKey` (YYYY-MM-DD), `dueCount`, `doneCount`, `urgencyScore`, `orbitIndex` | string / int | `dayKey` valid date; counts ≥ 0 | `tintoo_ring_v1` | | `TintCareEntry` | `id`, `planId`, `dayKey`, `title`, `careKind` (`rinse`/`mask`/`gloss`/`check`), `status` (`due`/`done`/`skipped`), `dueAt`, `note`, `photoPath`, `updatedAt` | mixed | `title` 1–48; `planId` must exist; `careKind` enum only | `tintoo_entries_v1` | | `PeriodExportSnapshot` | `id`, `rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`, `dueTotal`, `doneTotal`, `planBreakdown[]`, `cardLayoutRev` | mixed | range ≤ 31 days; totals derived | `tintoo_exports_v1` | | `WalletState` | `coinBalance`, `freeExportsRemaining` | int | balances ≥ 0 | `tintoo_wallet_v1` | **Relations:** `WaterMatchPlan` 1:N `TintCareEntry`; `RingDayNode.dueCount` / `doneCount` are derived from entries with matching `dayKey`; `PeriodExportSnapshot.planBreakdown` aggregates due and done counts per plan for the selected range. **Derived fields:** `urgencyScore` = `dueCount * 3 + overdueBonus` where overdueBonus adds +2 per entry with `status=due` and `dueAt` before now; `planPeriodDue` = count of `status=due` entries for a plan in range. ## Business Rules Engine **BR-01 Ring landing lock** — On cold entry to Tab 1, render the reminder ring as the primary zone. If zero `WaterMatchPlan` records exist, show domain empty copy and disable capture until the first plan is created. Feedback: toast “Create a water-match plan first.” **BR-02 Plan label uniqueness** — Creating a plan with a duplicate `planLabel` (case-insensitive trim) is rejected. Feedback: inline error “That plan label is already in use.” **BR-03 Hardness & cadence bounds** — Capture/edit of plan fields must keep `waterHardnessPpm` in 0–500 and cadence days in 1–30. Feedback: “Hardness 0–500 ppm; cadence 1–30 days.” **BR-04 Due roll-up** — Any create/update/delete of `TintCareEntry` recomputes `RingDayNode` counts and `urgencyScore` for that `dayKey` before UI refresh. **BR-05 Agenda sort** — Day agenda lists `due` before `done`, then by `dueAt` ascending, then title. If Welcome not completed, route `#/welcome`; user checks Privacy + Terms, finishes three theme slides, taps Continue → persist `welcome_done_v1=true` → `#/ring`. 3. Tab 1 Hub shows reminder-ring hero (orbit day nodes sized by `urgencyScore`) — **signature interaction available here** (step 5). 4. User creates at least one `WaterMatchPlan` from Plans tab or Hub CTA (BR-01/BR-02/BR-03); hardness, pH band, rinse recipe, and cadence fields persist. 5. **Signature:** User drags/spins the ring then taps a day node; Hub highlights the node and opens quick path to that `dayKey` (binds to steps 6–7). 6. User opens `#/capture` (or capture sheet from Hub) for the selected day; fills title, linked plan, care kind, and note text when provided. 7. User attaches a care-check photo via Bridge `pickImage` (BR-08) when a visual gloss check is required; thumbnail resolves through `mediaServe` (`readFile` Bridge base64 inline for display). 8. Save creates `TintCareEntry` with `status=due`; BR-04 updates `RingDayNode`; toast “Care step pinned to the ring.” 9. User opens `#/agenda` or `#/day` for the dyed-hair day agenda; BR-05 sort applies; marking Done sets `status=done` and refreshes plan period totals. 10. User selects a period on `#/export`; UI computes due/done totals and plan breakdown into a period reminder card preview (same layout as final export). 11. User confirms Export: if `freeExportsRemaining > 0`, consume one free slot (BR-06); else spend 30 coins (BR-07). Preview pixels export 1:1 — no post-scale that warps type; preview art must not export blank. 12. Bridge `saveImageToAlbum` writes the card; success toast “Reminder card saved.” On insufficient coins, step routes to `#/store` → Bridge `purchase` → resume export. ## Secondary Workflows ### Flow A — Edit / soft-archive a care entry 1. From Agenda or Day Detail, tap a care row. 2. Edit title, care kind, plan link, or due time (BR-03 when plan fields change). 3. Save mutates `TintCareEntry` and runs BR-04 ring roll-up. 4. Choose Archive → confirm → `status=skipped` (BR-09). 5. Toast “Moved off the due ring.” 6. Empty agenda copy appears when no `due` items remain for that day. ### Flow B — Water-plan review then top-up 1. Open `#/plans`; select a water-match plan panel. 2. Review hardness, rinse recipe, cadence, and period due counts for that plan. 3. Jump to `#/agenda` filtered to that plan’s open care entries. 4. Complete or recapture care steps; ring urgency refreshes live (BR-04). 5. If export later needs coins, open `#/settings` wallet → `#/store`. 6. # Tintoo Privacy Agreement

Latest Updated: May 18, 2026

Tintoo is a beauty and personal-care utility that presents a gloss-care reminder-ring workspace for hair-color care cycle tracking and water-quality matched care plans through an on-device web layer hosted by a native shell. Tintoo is rated **18+**. By installing or using Tintoo you confirm that you are at least **18 years** of age and that you understand this Privacy Agreement. This document explains how Tintoo handles information in a tool context that does not require an account, social profile, or cloud identity. The product is designed for adult users who want local care-day rings, water-match plan fields, day agendas, and period reminder card exports without building a networked profile.

## Your Rights and Choices

You control the local care workspace content you create. Inside Tintoo you can edit or delete water-match plans, rewrite care entry titles and notes, replace care-check photos, soft-archive due steps so they leave the reminder ring, and clear export previews you no longer need. You can stop camera or photos access by denying permission at the prompt or by removing granted access in system settings; denying a permission blocks only the related capture or save action and does not erase care cycles already stored on the device. Because Tintoo does not maintain a cloud account, there is no remote profile ticket; uninstalling the application removes the app sandbox data subject to ordinary operating-system retention rules for deleted applications. You can also stop using Tintoo at any time without submitting a separate logout flow, since the product does not operate login, register, or logout screens.

## Information We Collect

Tintoo does not ask you to create a username, email login, password, or social profile. The product does not operate a cloud identity system, does not sell personal profiles, and does not build a cross-application advertising graph from your care workspace. Labels, hardness values, rinse recipes, and notes you enter are treated as local workspace text, not as a public profile. Where the shell needs a stable technical handle for purchase receipt fulfillment, crash-safe wallet writes, or local vault integrity checks, Tintoo may rely on a device-unique identifier generated or provided by the operating environment. That identifier is used only to keep local service state coherent across sessions on the same installation. It is not treated as a public profile name, is not shown to other users, is not combined into marketing audiences inside Tintoo, and is cleared when you remove the application together with its local sandbox data under ordinary operating-system deletion rules.

## Local Care Workspace Data

Tintoo stores water-match plans including plan labels, water hardness values, pH bands, rinse recipes, and mask or gloss cadence days. Tintoo also stores ring day nodes with due and done counts, tint care entries linked to plans and day keys, period export snapshots with due totals and plan breakdowns, and coin or free-export balances used for period reminder card saves. Relative paths to photos you attach while capturing a care-check remain in the application sandbox so Ring Hub, Plans, Agenda, and Export screens can reopen quickly after the app is backgrounded or relaunched on the same device. These records exist to support hair-color care cycle tracking and period reminder export; they are not uploaded to a Tintoo-operated content feed as part of the standard product flow described in the feature specification.

## Photos and Media

If you capture a care-check photo or save a period reminder card to your photo library, Tintoo requests camera or photos permission at the moment of that action. Media files are written under the app sandbox using relative paths and are shown through the shell media channel using the declared read-file display path for thumbnails. Tintoo does not upload your care photos to a Tintoo-operated server as part of the standard product flow. Denying permission prevents that specific capture or save action and does not otherwise block browsing of local text plans and agendas already stored on the device. You remain responsible for only attaching media you are entitled to store on the device.

## Technical Protection Measures

Tintoo keeps workspace records inside the application sandbox and relies on operating-system isolation between applications. Relative media paths are preferred over absolute filesystem strings so the hosted web layer does not receive broader device path information than required for persistence keys. Bridge exchanges for purchases, media, and device layout information are scoped to declared actions. Local wallet balances and free-export counters are written with crash-safe patterns intended to avoid partial credits after a successful store transaction. These technical measures reduce accidental exposure of sandbox files to other applications on the same device; they do not replace your responsibility to protect physical access to an unlocked device.

## Administrative Handling Practices

Tintoo does not staff a cloud moderation desk that continuously reviews private care notes, because the product is local-first and does not publish a public feed. Support correspondence you send by email is used only to respond to your request, investigate a report, or clarify how local deletion works on your installation. Tintoo retains support email only as long as needed to resolve the inquiry and then discards it under ordinary mailbox hygiene. Where a report concerns abusive misuse of labels, notes, or exported reminder cards, Tintoo documents the handling steps needed to guide removal of offending local content and to restrict further support associated with abusive use. Tool compliance adaptation for this utility also expects users to keep entered hardness and recipe fields accurate for their own planning and to refrain from using the workspace to store unrelated identity documents.

## Purchases

Coin packs identified as Tints series products are consumable in-app purchases processed by the platform store framework. Tintoo receives product identifiers and fulfillment results needed to credit a local coin balance after a successful transaction. Tintoo does not receive your full payment card number and does not store bank credentials. Purchase history relevant to completing a local balance credit after a successful transaction is handled according to the store framework on your device. Consumable coins are not restored as a transferable cloud balance across new devices beyond what unfinished store transactions themselves require. Prices and pack sizes shown in the in-app store interface are fulfilled only after the platform confirms a successful consumable purchase.

This version of Tintoo does not ship third-party advertising analytics software development kits that profile you across other applications. Operational logs that remain on device may help diagnose bridge failures during development builds and are not a substitute for a cloud telemetry product. Tintoo does not sell local care workspace content to data brokers. If a future build introduces additional diagnostics, this Privacy Agreement will be updated with a new Latest Updated date before those diagnostics become active in a production release.

## Content Safety and Reporting

Tintoo maintains **zero tolerance** for abusive, exploitative, or unlawful misuse of local labels, care notes, plan titles, or exported period reminder cards. The product applies **filtering methods** appropriate to a utility workspace and provides a **user reporting mechanism** so that concerns can be submitted through the contact channel below. When a substantiated report arrives, Tintoo aims to take action within **24 hours**, including guidance to remove offending local content where feasible and restriction of further support associated with the report. Adults who store hair-care notes remain responsible for entering only appropriate content and for keeping the device under adult control.

## Children's Privacy

Tintoo is intended only for users who are **18+**. Tintoo does not knowingly collect personal information from children. Care notes and plan labels entered by an adult remain local workspace content under the adult user’s control. If you believe a minor has provided information despite this age gate, contact the address below so the local data can be guided toward deletion on the affected device.

When this Privacy Agreement changes, the Latest Updated date at the top will change as well. Continued use of Tintoo after an update means you accept the revised text for subsequent sessions. Material changes that affect how local data is stored will be reflected in the updated wording of this document before those changes apply to new sessions.

## Contact Us

# Tintoo User Agreement

Latest Updated: May 18, 2026

Tintoo grants access when the application is installed on your device and the hosted web workspace loads inside the native shell. There is no separate account registration, login, or logout flow. Attempting to tamper with free-export counters, coin balances, or bridge purchase callbacks is a material breach of these terms.

You agree to use Tintoo lawfully and to enter only content you are entitled to store on the device. Plan labels, care notes, hardness values, and rinse recipes must not impersonate others for harassment or store unlawful material. You are responsible for permissions you grant for camera or photos when capturing care-check images or saving reminder cards. You must not use Bridge plaza surfaces for unauthorized probing outside legitimate support contexts. Adults who keep hair-care notes on a shared device must keep the device under adult supervision and must avoid entering sensitive identifiers that are unnecessary for local planning. Hardness and recipe fields are personal planning aids you enter yourself; Tintoo does not guarantee laboratory accuracy of those values.

## Tool Compliance Cooperation

Because Tintoo is a utility that relies on device permissions and store fulfillment, you agree to cooperate with reasonable compliance requests that keep the tool lawful to operate. Cooperation includes responding to a content safety inquiry sent to the contact address, confirming whether offending local text or media can be deleted on your device, and refraining from repeated attempts to bypass export gates after a purchase or free-tier limit is enforced. Your locally entered plan labels, care notes, and photos remain yours; you grant Tintoo only the limited technical permission needed to display, export, and store them on your device as the product functions require. Tintoo is provided for practical personal hair-color care planning around reminder-ring days, water-match plan fields, and period due counts.
